Administrator Manual
KICC Digital Economy Platform — Admin Guide v1.0
1. Accessing the Admin Panel
Login at
kicctest.org/login
with KICC admin credentials. After login, you are redirected to the admin portal.
2. KICC Admin Dashboard
Navigate to
/kicc-admin
for the full admin dashboard with tabs: Overview, Sub-Portals, Counties, Exhibitors, National Govt, Orders, Providers, Escrow, Users, Trade Enquiries, Agents, Reviews, Commissions, Coupons.
3. County Admin
Each county has its own admin at
/county-admin/{slug}/pro
with tabs for content, images, prices, sectors, marketplace, 4D videos, ads, packages, reports.
4. Agent Onboarding
Agents register at
/agents/register
. Admin reviews at
/kicc-admin/agents
— approve/reject, verify documents, set commission rate.
5. Moderation
Reviews:
/kicc-admin/reviews
— approve/reject user reviews.
Trade Enquiries:
/kicc-admin/trade/enquiries
— update status, add admin notes.
6. Commissions & Coupons
Commissions:
auto-tracked per order at
/kicc-admin/commissions
.
Coupons:
create at
/kicc-admin/coupons
.
7. Mobile Apps
Public app:
kicc-mobile/public/
— Flutter/Dart. Admin app:
kicc-mobile/admin/
— Flutter/Dart. Build with
flutter build apk
or
flutter build ios
.
8. Deployment
Git push to
main
→ Laravel Cloud auto-deploys. Droplet at
root@167.172.62.234
— deploy via
rsync
+
php artisan config:cache
+
systemctl restart php8.4-fpm
.
